id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

evaluators.description: List of {@link MlModel.Evaluator}s to be executed in this {@link MlModel.Evaluation.Job}.

title:
Represents an evaluation job for executing many {@link MlModel.Evaluators} for many {@link MlModel}s.
All models should be within the scope of a single {@link MlProject}.
Each model will be evaluated against every evaluator specified in {@link #evaluators}.
The {@link #evaluators} may be customized per model as per {@link MlModel.Evaluator#evaluatorForModel}.

Example usage:
```python
#Step 1 - Create evaluators
evaluator_usa = c3.MlModel.Evaluator(
  id='USA_2020_simple',
  scope=c3.MlModel.Evaluator.Scope(
    subjectFilter="country=='USA'",
    start="2020-01-01",
    end="2020-12-31"
  ),
  operations={
    "accuracy": c3.MlModel.Evaluator.ModelMetric(metricNames=["score_accuracy_out"])
  }
).create()

evaluator_canada = c3.MlModel.Evaluator(
  id='CAN_2020_simple',
  scope=c3.MlModel.Evaluator.Scope(
    subjectFilter="country=='CAN'",
    start="2020-01-01",
    end="2020-12-31"
  ),
  operations={
    "accuracy": c3.MlModel.Evaluator.ModelMetric(metricNames=["score_accuracy_out"])
  }
).create()

#Step 2 - Create job
evaluation_job = c3.MlModel.Evaluation.Job(evaluators=[evaluator_usa, evaluator_canada]).create()

#Step 3 - Start the execution of evaluation job using models
operation_run = evaluation_job.start(models=[MlModel1, MlModel2])

#(OR) Step 3 - Start the execution of evaluation job using completed MlModel.Train.JobRun
operation_run = evaluation_job.start(trainJobRun=train_job_run)

#Step 4 - Get all evaluation results
evaluation_job_run = operation_run.result()
evaluation_results = evaluation_job_run.evaluationResults()
```
name: MlModel.Evaluation.Job
